card.name: Inside cross-references and product names
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation partway through a bracketed section cross-reference such as [see Dosage and Administration (2.2, 2.3, 2.4)], or inside a multi-word product name. It also fires on 'with' in '(with epinephrine)' in dosing tables.

modes.label: Cross-reference brackets
modes.description: Pieces inside a 'see Dosage and Administration (2.x)' reference, including the error text and commas between section numbers.

modes.label: Inside product names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long drug or product names, often repeated within a sentence.
